description: Tech_quoz is a passionate team of aspiring developers, innovators, and problem-solvers participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are interested in building innovative solutions using AI, machine learning, software development, and data analysis to solve real-world challenges related to Earth and space. We welcome enthusiastic teammates with skills in coding, UI/UX design, research, data science, and creative problem-solving. Let's innovate together!
